Interior Painting & Wall Preparation in Dubai

A handover repaint in an empty apartment and a colour change in a furnished villa need different preparation. Tell ServiceBay which rooms, ceilings and trims you want painted, who occupies the space and when the finish needs to be ready for inspection.

Estimate costWhatsAppCall 056 201 4647

Mon–Sat, 8:00 AM–6:00 PM · Dubai time

Key benefits

  • A finish agreed in the room’s light
  • Cleaner edges around trim
  • A colour reference for future touch-ups

From surface preparation to the final coat

List walls, ceilings, doors and skirting separately. A small room with several doors and built-in wardrobes may have less wall area but more edges to protect and finish. Include nail holes, hairline marks, peeling paint and old adhesive in the brief. These details determine how much filling, sanding and priming the quote should include.

Work you can request

  • Filling and surface preparation
  • Colour and sheen matching
  • Walls, ceilings and trim
  • Move-out repainting

Most common problems

  • Patches catch the light
  • Paint flakes at the edges
  • A rental handover requires a colour change

Working to a handover date?

Send the move-out date, room count and landlord’s finish requirements. Dispatch can check a schedule that allows time for preparation and drying.

Why preparation changes the finish

Daylight can reveal a patch that disappeared under a work light. Agreeing the preparation area, sheen and natural stopping edges helps the repaired wall read as one surface.

Common component failures & expert repair solutions

ComponentWhat you may noticeHow we address it
Existing paint filmEdges lift around a patch.Remove loose coating and prime the sound substrate.
Filler or jointA repaired strip shows through.Level and prime the joint before recoating.
Topcoat finishA touch-up flashes under side lighting.Match the sheen and recoat to a natural edge.
Stained substrateA dry stain bleeds through fresh paint.Confirm the moisture source is resolved before applying a stain-blocking primer.

Before & after service

Before the visit

Mark the holes, flaking edges and stains. Compare the proposed sample beside the existing paint in daylight.

At handover

Review coverage, edges and filled areas under normal room lighting. Keep the agreed product and colour code.

Work by property type

Residential

In an apartment, confirm the landlord’s handover colour and whether ceiling touch-ups, door frames or balcony surfaces are included. In a furnished villa, agree which rooms can be emptied together and where furniture can be moved between phases.

Commercial

For an office, shop or reception, identify high-traffic surfaces and specify the sheen or washability you need. Agree when staff can re-enter each room and who will protect signs, display units and stock.

Industrial

For staff facilities, corridors and warehouse offices, give wall heights and describe access around shelving. Specialist industrial coatings, machine painting and floor marking require separate confirmation from ordinary interior wall painting.

Paint brands & finishes

If matching Jotun or Dulux, send the colour code, product line and sheen. A sample compared in the room helps settle the finish before paint is ordered.

Planning the work room by room

Send room photos and an approximate wall area. After a survey, confirm preparation, sample colour, paint system and coats in writing. Agree a sequence for clearing and protecting rooms. At handover, review the finish in the room’s normal light and record the paint reference for future touch-ups.

What changes a painting estimate?

Wall condition, colour change, height, occupied rooms and the number of separate surfaces affect the scope. Ask whether the quote includes materials, masking, furniture protection and cleanup. For a move-out, check it against the landlord’s written requirements before you approve.

FAQ

Frequently asked questions about Painting

Can a scuff be touched up instead of painting the wall?

Send a photo in daylight and the original paint details. A touch-up may be suitable in a discreet area. On a prominent wall, painting to a natural edge can give a more even result.

How do I choose a white for a rental handover?

Ask the landlord or managing agent for the exact code and sheen. Where neither is available, agree on a sample and keep a written record of the choice.

Are ceilings included in the room rate?

Specify ceilings as separate surfaces. Height, existing marks, fixtures and access can change the preparation and the time required.

Can you paint around furniture?

Give the room layout and identify items that are heavy or fixed. The quote can then state who moves furniture and what will be covered in place.

How long before we can use the room again?

Ask for a room-by-room schedule based on the chosen product, drying conditions and number of coats. Share your handover or reopening date when requesting the quote.
